description: This file defines a Java interface 'ProductOptionDao' for data access operations related to product options in an e-commerce system. It extends a generic DAO interface and declares methods for retrieving, saving, and updating ProductOption entities, specifically tailored for a store and language context.

classes.name: ProductOptionDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object interface for product options, providing methods to query and manipulate ProductOption entities within a store and language context.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductOptions available for a specific store and language.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductOptions matching a specific name within a store and language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Persists a new or updated ProductOption entity; may throw a ServiceException.

methods.name: getReadOnly
methods.description: Fetches read-only ProductOptions for a store and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductOption by its unique code within a store.
